page.layout: One printed page, one text column with a narrow margin of notes on the right side. Running head and page number at the top. No catchword or signature at the foot.

main_text.p: redduntur: vtraque vero alimento parum a- pta deprehenditur. Galenus commendat eas uvas, quæ duriori funt callo & acino(vn- de duracinæ appellantur) folidioris quæ substantiæ, minusque liquoris habeant, has e- nim valentius nutrire affirmat.

Verum de conditura vuarum operæ pre- Quæ ra- tium eft aliquid meminiffe, multiplici enim tione vuæ modo in annuos referuantur vfus. Principio condian- adnotaffe hic lectorem oportet, vuam fine tur ac fer- noxaferuari, fi luna decrefcente ferenoque uentur? cælo colligatur, id quod & de feminibus & fructibus intelligendum. Rationem in Cur luna promtu effe animaduertes, fi confideraueris, decrefcen vim alimentorum infuauem crudumq; fuc- te puroq cum, qui fæpe in feminibus fructibus usque de- cælo vuæ litefcit, folis virtute caftigari corrigique, hu- feminaq iufque actione inutilem humiditatem exugi, fint colli- fopitumque ac deperditum faporem reftitui gendæ atque reuocari. Cæterum Columella re- fert inter multos feruandarum vuarum mo- dos huncextitiffe fere precipuum, quando in labello fictili nouo, paleis quam ficciffimis cribatis, vt fine puluere effent, impleto, vuæ condebantur, deinde labellum luto paleato circumlinitum in tabulato ficciffimo paleis Quid v- ficciffimis obruebatur, talesq; vuas paleales uæ palea- vocarunt, quæ humore fuperuacaneo fpolia- les, & fa- tæ ægris impune concedebantur. Quæ autem brilæ? in officinis fabrorum ferrariorum fufpende- bantur,

page.notes: The margin notes on the right are small and cramped, and several are read with doubt; they are marked as best I could read them. "Quæ ra-", "tione vuæ", "condian-", "tur ac fer-", "uentur?", "decrefcen", "feminaq", "fint colli-", "gendæ", "Quid v-", "uæ palea-", "les, & fa-" and "brilæ?" are the readings most in doubt. The running head and the first note line are also uncertain. The ligature and abbreviation forms in the notes may not match the printer's exactly.
